name: Ritz to Live
source:
"Ritz to Live" is a Visual Novel where players play as Ritz, a telephone marketer who was hit by a truck on his way home. Ritz wakes up and finds himself transported to another world where its suspiciously beautiful, he works at a high paying job, but he's close to bankruptcy. Ritz will need to figure out a way home through learning more about the world, how he travelled, and the mysterious rat man that looks way too familiar; to escape a crippling debt that isn't even his.

[From [url=https://giogiogzg.itch.io/ritz-to-win]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Ritz to Live》是一款视觉小说，玩家扮演Ritz，一名电话营销员，在回家的路上被卡车撞倒。里兹醒来后发现自己穿越到了另一个世界，那里美丽得令人怀疑，他从事着一份高薪工作，但他却濒临破产。里兹需要通过更多地了解这个世界、他如何旅行以及看起来太熟悉的神秘鼠人来找到回家的路；为了逃避一笔甚至不属于他的沉重债务。

[来自[url=https://giogiogzg.itch.io/ritz-to-win]itch.io[/url]]
